change.description: A requested Neri delivery uses the repaired loading stairs, gallery, descent and open bell arch. Manual pickup, waiting and in-person interception remain distinct choices.
change.custody: One spindle moves from bench to porter to apprentice to finishing table. Arrival never grants the item or pays a reward.
change.recovery: Repeated requests do not duplicate goods. Carried cancellations return physically during play. Ready orders wait indefinitely. Reload uses named loading/bell/bench checkpoints, not exact saved transit poses.

library_and_roadmap.reconciliation: PR157 already implemented the showcase, three approaches, permanent arch, notebook, maps and spatial XR. This pass adds useful resident behavior rather than rebuilding those features.
library_and_roadmap.metadata_rule: This receipt and PR167 supersede the immutable prepublication pending labels in the source handoff.

verification.evidence_class: Hosted Chromium and actual Three/WebGL drawing with emulated Xbox and WebXR input. Not physical-device or human-playtest approval.

preservation.concurrent_change: Only the Vesperfall Open Line workflow changed after the release; it is preserved. The receipt is outside the tested game tree.

play.requirements: For an unfinished spindle follow-up, report the Missing Commission, repair the loading drive and open the arch. Accept the spindle delivery from Leonardo.
play.action: Stop at the workshop-side bell, press X and request Neri. Close the dialog to let the simulation run. Collect from him at the bell or meet him on the goods route, then personally deliver to Ilaria.
play.alternative: Manual collection at Marta remains available unless Neri already carries the spindle. Completed deliveries remain completed and cannot pay again.
play.existing_save: Do not reset storage. Existing town saves can enter the Quarter on foot beside Leonardo near (-5,-6).

controlled_route_experiment.method: Earned social case and arch, then explicitly cloned counterfactual trials using unmodified fixed-step movement and validated actions. No actor-coordinate or progression assignments. Not a browser or human timing study.
controlled_route_experiment.interpretation: The chosen bell plan saves walking but waits longer. Gallery interception reduces waiting and takes a different learned route. These selected paths are not shortest-path optima or evidence of enjoyment.

first_publication_attempt.cause: Checked before queued Pages deployment; saw old files or missing new modules. Retained as failure, then rerun after Pages with no runtime or assertion changes.

diagnostics_and_limits.native_trace_clock: porter-trace.json timestamps are null. Position/phase traces remain useful; do not infer timing or velocity from them. The separate CPU experiment counts simulation steps explicitly.
diagnostics_and_limits.minor_feedback_issue: In the bell and gallery CPU trials, completed-delivery wording says Neri has returned while his actual phase is going-home. Custody, physical return and rewards remain correct. Phase-aware completion copy is a recorded next fix.
diagnostics_and_limits.presentation: Simple carrying props, body overlap and unfinished articulation remain graybox-level. Captures do not establish comfortable headset readability.
diagnostics_and_limits.cloudflare: Separate premerge preview failures were recorded; they are not the successful GitHub Pages deployment.

next_level_design_opportunity: Observe whether players choose manual collection, bell waiting or gallery interception for a reason. Improve useful observation during waits, timing and phase-specific feedback before expanding the district. Keep broad W04/W05/S02/NEXT06 and physical/human gates open.
